The one address outside Kuala Lumpur, and the best connected of the four. Villamas built Meta City on Jalan Atmosphere Utama 2 in Pusat Bandar Putra Permai as a whole mixed quarter — a 39-storey residential tower of SoHos and serviced apartments, 1,452 homes in all, over a lifestyle mall, a hotel and a corporate tower, with 4,500 parking bays beneath. Facilities are stacked into a Sky Club at the top: pool and pool lounge, jacuzzi, viewing deck, gymnasium, games room, reading room, basketball court and BBQ terrace. Taman Equine MRT is five to eight minutes away on foot, on the Putrajaya Line that runs straight into the city centre. Rooms are fully furnished and managed end to end by BeLive.

Mah Sing’s landmark on Jalan Cheras: five towers, 3,684 units, and a 4.54-acre podium that is still the largest recreational deck in Kuala Lumpur. Thirty-eight facilities sit on it — a 50-metre pool, a 4,000 sq ft gymnasium, a 400-metre jogging and cycling loop, tennis, futsal, basketball and badminton courts, a tea garden and a maze garden. The Maluri MRT–LRT interchange is 550 m away under cover, which puts the campus a single change away. Rooms are fully furnished and managed end to end by BeLive, with Master, Double and Single types available.

Eupe Corporation’s Parc3 stands as a single 39-storey block of 793 units at Taman Pudu Ulu, completed in 2021. Its forty-odd facilities are arranged as active, passive, leisure and healthy zones rather than one flat deck — a cascading waterfall running down the podium, a celebrity kitchen, a business centre, a herb garden, pool, sauna, gymnasium and a jogging track. Taman Pertama on the Kajang Line is the nearest station, ten minutes on foot. Rooms are fully furnished and managed end to end by BeLive.

The newest address of the four. MKH Berhad handed over Nexus @ Taman Pertama in 2025 — one freehold 41-storey tower of 507 units on Jalan Cheras, built as a transit-oriented development with Taman Pertama on the Kajang Line 150 m from the lobby. Three whole levels are given over to facilities and planting, topped by a sky infinity pool, a sky lounge and a gymnasium with the Cheras skyline on three sides. Rooms are fully furnished and managed end to end by BeLive.
